paper_title: Audio-Visual Efficient Conformer for Robust Speech Recognition
caption: Audio-only back-end modules FLOPs (Billion).
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the computational cost of different audio-only back-end Conformer modules in terms of FLOPs (billions) across three Audio back-end Conformer stages. The horizontal axis contains the categorical stages labeled, from left to right, “Stage 1 (d=180, n=500),” “Stage 2 (d=256, n=250),” and “Stage 3 (d=360, n=125),” under the axis title “Audio back-end Conformer Stage.” The vertical axis is a linear scale labeled “Module GigaFLOPs,” spanning from 0 to 0.3 with evenly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals (0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3). Each stage shows a group of four adjacent bars corresponding to the legend categories: attention (blue), grouped attention (g=3) (red), patch attention (k=3) (yellow), and feed-forward (green). In Stage 1, the blue attention bar is approximately 0.275 GigaFLOPs, the red grouped attention bar about 0.155, the yellow patch attention bar about 0.115, and the green feed-forward bar about 0.13. In Stage 2, the blue attention bar is about 0.16, the red grouped attention about 0.12, the yellow patch attention about 0.105, and the green feed-forward about 0.13. In Stage 3, the blue attention bar is about 0.118, the red grouped attention about 0.103, the yellow patch attention about 0.098, and the green feed-forward about 0.13. The bars are grouped by stage with no stacking, and the stages appear in numeric order (1 through 3) without additional sorting or visual emphasis such as annotations or outlines.
